items.text: Hi, is the Pixel 7 still available? Is the battery still good?
Yes, it is available. Battery health is 91%, I can show you at the meetup.
Great. Can we meet at Dhanmondi Police Station on Saturday afternoon?
Is the lamp still available for pickup on Friday?
Also, can you drop the price a little?
One more question about the box.
One more question about the box.
Yes, I can do 1,400 for pickup.
